=== Purpose ===
To bring together many of our [[Kindred]] for a festival of sharing.  Like individual cells working in the pattern of a human body, we as individuals and organizations work within the pattern of [[The Body of All Life]].  Let's share the how we each and we all are helping [[The Body of All Life]] thrive.  Share ideas, make connections, and inspire each other about what is possible at [[Kindred2010]] ... a festival celebrating life!
